summary: WhatsApp gaps from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations v2 (revision 378e5ca2), scenes f-big, v-fail and v-budget. Media ingest now returns MEDIA_TOO_LARGE when the provider download or the attachment size limit refuses a file (before any private write), and TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED when a voice note's processing failed. Three fixed notices replace the generic MEDIA_FAILED for these cases: MEDIA_TOO_LARGE (attach in the same chat in EwaTrade or use Import; nothing saved), VOICE_FAILED (type it or record again; nothing done) and VOICE_UNAVAILABLE (voice notes paused right now; type instead). Voice notices omit the app link. Local only; media stays off in Production, and no provider, OTP or deployment change.
noAssistantImpact: Channel transport notices only. No tool, prompt, capability declaration, write or authority changes; the codes are fixed strings and raw adapter errors still never reach a reply.

evidence.result: 3 pass: refusal codes map to MEDIA_TOO_LARGE, VOICE_FAILED and VOICE_UNAVAILABLE; voice notices carry no link.
With notice.test.ts: 10 pass, 72 expects. A MEDIA_TOO_LARGE download stops after authorize and download with no intent or storage write.
Database integration suite not run in this change; voice cancel and review paths are unchanged.
